title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors allows every origin
description: A policy lets every origin frame the document. frame-ancestors is the CSP control that stops clickjacking, and a wildcard turns it into a no-op while the security review sees a CSP header present and assumes the surface is covered.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk: Clickjacking protection disabled by policy; MEDIUM severity.
